_status: DRAFT 2026-11-18, NOT AGREED. Commit only after the team and supervisor agree, and BEFORE any H22-clean model run (baselines included). Once committed, nothing in this file changes; the git log is the record.
_why: Pl@ntNet-300K is now the development set: its V-select and test results have been seen (week-2 gate FAIL, results/RUNS.md). H22-clean is untouched, herbarium (the IJCNN paper's domain) and taxonomically rich, so it is where a taxonomy method is tested once, under rules fixed in advance.
_hypothesis: On frozen features, taxonomy-guided feature calibration (C2) on top of a tau-norm linear probe improves macro-F1 and few-shot accuracy over the best tuned baseline, and the gain comes from the real taxonomy (shuffled taxonomy keeps less than half of it). Chosen from the Pl@ntNet results: tau_norm+c2 was the best method on the Pl@ntNet test set for DINOv2 and BioCLIP 2.
configs: configs/h22clean_<encoder>.json (with posthoc_grid = true and c2_prior = augmented, committed together with this file)

encoders._note: Primary encoders decide the verdict. DINOv2 is the leakage control (BioCLIP 2's training data may include herbarium images from GBIF). CLIP B/32 is the IJCNN backbone: reported for continuity, not decisive.

a9._runs: tau_norm+c2fshuf, tau_norm+c2fshuf@c2_shuffle_seed=1, tau_norm+c2fshuf@c2_shuffle_seed=2: same frozen base and the same candidate configurations as tau_norm+c2f (lt.harness.search_seed_key), each searched and re-tuned with the same trial budget.

tuning._note: Same budget for every method. +c2f freezes the tuned tau_norm config, so tau_norm must finish first. Only C2's settings (tau_mu, k, rank, n_min) and test_tau are searched for C2 and its controls. A9 controls need only seed 0 on test.

selection.best_baseline: highest V-select macro-F1 among the baselines (favours the baseline)
selection.c2_method: highest V-tune score among c2_methods (one method here, so no choice is made)

criteria.criterion1: C2 vs best baseline on H22-clean test (training seed 0): macro-F1 by paired randomization test, one-sided p < alpha; AND pooled few-shot accuracy (train count < 20) by exact McNemar with C2 ahead, p < alpha. Class-stratified bootstrap 95% CIs are reported, not decisive.
criteria.criterion2_a9: Real C2 beats EACH shuffled-taxonomy run on macro-F1 (paired randomization, one-sided p < alpha), and the mean shuffled macro-F1 keeps less than max_gain_retained of C2's gain over tau_norm.
criteria._reported_not_decisive: seed spread (3 seeds) of every method; per-group accuracy; C2 vs tau_norm (same base); everything on clip_b32

verdict.all_primary_pass: Method paper: benchmark + C2 as a method contribution (plan section 17, row 2).
verdict.some_primary_pass: Analysis paper; C2 reported as an encoder-dependent component, with this result.
verdict.no_primary_pass: Analysis paper (docs/PLAN_ANALYSIS.md); C2 reported as a negative result on both datasets.
